acceptance.label: Holdout sales valued
acceptance.basis: Abstention is reported, not hidden; at least 90% of screened holdout sales must receive a valuation.

acceptance.label: Median absolute percentage error
acceptance.basis: Typical published off-market AVM accuracy is in the single digits to low teens; 10% is the pre-registered bar.

acceptance.label: Share within ±10% of sale price
acceptance.basis: Industry PPE10 convention: at least half of sales within ten percent.

acceptance.label: Coefficient of dispersion (COD)
acceptance.basis: IAAO Standard on Ratio Studies (2013), residential upper bound of 15.

acceptance.label: Price-related differential (PRD)
acceptance.basis: IAAO Standard on Ratio Studies (2013) vertical-equity range 0.98–1.03.

acceptance.label: Absolute median signed error
acceptance.basis: Systematic over- or under-valuation must stay within ±3%.

acceptance.label: Beats median $/sqft of the same comparables
acceptance.basis: Paired bootstrap 95% upper bound of the MdAPE difference must be below zero: adjustments must add value.

acceptance.label: Beats trailing ZIP median price
acceptance.basis: Paired bootstrap 95% upper bound of the MdAPE difference must be below zero.

acceptance.label: Calibrated 80% interval coverage
acceptance.basis: Out-of-sample coverage of the calibrated interval must land within five points of its 80% target.

statement: New experiment after the published Maryland failure. July–September 2026 outcomes have not been scored or used to select rates. The snapshot was previously bundled, and monthly counts and interface examples were inspected; this is a temporal, previously unscored holdout, not prospective collection. Register and commit before running. A $50,000 minimum consideration applies to every primary window and comparable pool. Fit nonnegative paired-sale rates with the original Huber method, fixing the quality coefficient at $75,000 and refitting other coefficients if the unconstrained fit exceeds that cap. Nine acceptance bars unchanged. Separately publish all-positive-consideration sensitivity with the frozen primary configuration and calibration; no refitting, screening by residual, or acceptance substitution. Short holdout and recording lag limit generalization. Never overwrite Maryland v1.
